answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 182 identities means 182 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the trellis pair is tracked in the plume ledger, the hollow audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward requires answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 59%. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
